subject: general
question: The famous Ajanta Caves, a world heritage site, is located at which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aurangabad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **30 caves at Ajanta** lie to the north of Aurangabad in the Indhyadri range of Western Ghats.
 
• The caves, famous for their **temple architecture and many delicately drawn murals**, are located on a 76 m high, horseshoe-shaped escarpment overlooking the Waghora (tiger) River.
